It is weakened by largely transferring an existing CoCrFeMnNi explanation and by treating similarity to that alloy as falsification, but B relies on unsupported assumptions that Co removal necessarily increases lattice distortion and lowers stacking-fault energy, while its maximum strain rate is not truly dynamic.
